fossilsense.serverPath.description: Path to fossilsense.exe. Empty uses the bundled extension binary, falling back to repository release/debug binaries during extension development.

fossilsense.mode.description: Overall FossilSense server mode. 'auto' starts FossilSense and reports a one-time coexistence warning if a known C/C++ or Go language server is detected; 'on' starts without that warning; 'off' prevents the server from starting.

fossilsense.completion.mode.description: Controls FossilSense completion, including ordinary identifiers, C/C++ include paths, indexed Go import paths, and degraded field/method member completion. 'auto' and 'on' enable completion; 'off' disables completion. Language-server conflicts are reported by fossilsense.mode, not silently handled per feature.

fossilsense.completion.prefixRanking.markdownDescription: Controls ordinary identifier completion when literal name matching conflicts with scope evidence. `strict` (default) orders exact names and case-insensitive literal prefixes ahead of fuzzy matches, then applies the existing scope/source/intent/project/history ranking within each match class. `_` is literal, so `wns_ipc` strictly prefixes `wns_ipc_send` but not `wns__ipc_rsp_init`. `scopeFirst` preserves the legacy behavior where Current/Reachable/External scope evidence may outrank a stronger Global name match. This does not affect include, member, workspace-symbol, navigation, reference, or coloring behavior.

fossilsense.completionHistory.mode.description: Controls local-only accepted-completion history used as a bounded positive-feedback ranking signal. 'auto' and 'on' record anonymous candidate hashes/buckets and use them for ranking; 'off' disables both. Use 'FossilSense: Clear Completion History' to remove local workspace history.

fossilsense.projectContext.mode.markdownDescription: Controls build-marker project evidence for ordinary identifier completion. `auto` uses the completion file's nearest in-scope marker, including Go module/workspace markers; `promptOnAmbiguous` also prompts once when an active C/C++ or Go file cannot be assigned while projects are available; `off` enforces baseline completion. Project context never filters candidates or changes navigation, references, coloring, member completion, or import/include completion.

fossilsense.semanticColoring.mode.description: Controls FossilSense semantic coloring of macros, types, enum constants, parameters, and local variables where the active language exposes those facts. 'auto' and 'on' enable coloring; 'off' disables coloring. Language-server conflicts are reported by fossilsense.mode. This is a degraded text/index-level colorer and may occasionally mis-color multi-meaning names.

fossilsense.includeScoping.mode.markdownDescription: Limited `#include` reachability scoping. When 'auto' (default), coloring and completion are narrowed using the current file's resolved include graph: coloring accepts exact reachable definitions, direct external headers, and bounded heuristic include targets, while excluding unrelated whole-workspace definitions when the scope is open; conflicting macro/type/enum kind evidence stays uncolored. Completion ranks stronger scope evidence first without dropping global fallback candidates. 'off' reverts both to whole-index behavior. This trades a little precision and recall for far less cross-file noise in large workspaces; it never errors.

fossilsense.semanticIndex.memoryBudgetMB.markdownDescription: Total memory target in MiB for the semantic declaration index. The compact completion recall core is always resident and is deducted first; the remainder caches canonical declaration payloads shared by completion resolve, Hover, and navigation. `0` keeps only the recall core and reads selected payloads from SQLite. Process/runtime memory is guarded separately by the large-workspace benchmark.

fossilsense.references.showRanges.markdownDescription: Show `:line` suffixes in the **Find References (Grouped by Role)** QuickPick. Off by default to keep labels focused on relative paths; selection still navigates to the full returned range.

fossilsense.resourceMonitor.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a status bar item with the FossilSense server's process memory and the on-disk size of its index cache. Updates every 5 seconds while the server is running. Does not affect server behavior; turning it off only hides the item.

fossilsense.includePaths.markdownDescription: External C/C++ header reference directories (absolute paths) used for `#include` path completion, `#include` jump-to-header, and degraded symbol indexing of those headers. This is **distinct** from workspace scope `include`/`exclude` (which selects workspace subtrees). Safe to point at a toolchain's include directory, e.g. `C:\TDM-GCC-64\x86_64-w64-mingw32\include`. Missing, inaccessible, or wrong-platform headers are skipped, never errors. Symbols from headers directly `#include`d by a workspace file also participate in semantic coloring; transitively-included ones do not.

fossilsense.goModulePaths.markdownDescription: Explicit external Go module directories to index without invoking the Go toolchain. Each root is scanned with independent file/byte caps and merged with `goModulePaths` from `fossilsense.json`. A root should contain `go.mod`; without module metadata, declarations remain bounded but import-path evidence may be incomplete. FossilSense never discovers or scans GOPATH or the machine module cache automatically. Missing, overlapping, or over-budget roots are skipped with visible degraded-status evidence.

fossilsense.protobufC.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt in to protobuf-c generated-type source tracing. When enabled with at least one valid proto directory, C/C++ type Hover may show matching `message` or `enum` declarations from `.proto` files. This does not add proto language support or change Go to Definition. An explicitly configured editor value overrides `protobufC.enabled` in `fossilsense.json`.

fossilsense.protobufC.protoPaths.markdownDescription: Absolute directories containing source `.proto` files for optional protobuf-c tracing. Entries are merged with workspace-relative or absolute `protobufC.protoPaths` from `fossilsense.json`, normalized, de-duplicated, and scanned only while protobuf-c tracing is enabled. Invalid or over-budget directories and proto files above the bounded extraction limits are skipped with a visible status warning.

fossilsense.debug.candidateReasons.markdownDescription: When enabled, **Go to Definition** logs each candidate's scope tier, confidence, and reason (e.g. `reachable`, `external_first_layer`, `global_fallback`) to the FossilSense output panel, so you can see why candidates ranked as they did. This is a best-effort debug aid; it never changes which definitions are returned. Off by default.

fossilsense.trace.server.description: Controls VS Code language client protocol tracing.
